description: Defines the SurveyResponses class for handling survey response data, email notifications, and case creation within SuiteCRM, an extension of SugarCRM.

classes.name: SurveyResponses
classes.description: A class extending Basic, managing survey response records, email notifications, and case creation logic.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates the class implements ACL interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey response, sends email, and creates case if needed based on response.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Prepares and sends email using templates, logs email activity.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates email template with contact and case data.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs email details into the Emails module.
